FOR THE OFFENCES P/U/S 498(A), 323, 504 R/W 149 OF IPC AND AS AGAINST THE PETITIONERS 1 TO 5/ACCUSED NO.2, 4, 5, 6 AND 7.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR HEARING, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Petitioners are accused No.2, 4, 5 to 7 respectively, in the charge sheet filed in connection with Crime No.65/2015 of A.P.M.C. Yard Police Station, Belguam.

Charge sheet is filed for the offence punishable under Section 498A, 323, 504 read with Section 149 of IPC.
2.
This petition is preferred under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. to quash the entire proceedings pending against the petitioners in C.C.1034/2015 on the file of the IV JMFC Court Belagavi.

3. Complaint is lodged by one Arathi Channagouda Hosamani/respondent No.2, against her husband and his NC: 2024:KHC-D:5375 relatives alleging physical and mental torture by them in connection with dowry etc.,
4.
Petitioners are the sisters, brother-in-law and uncle of accused No.1.
Omnibus allegations are made that even they were giving physical and mental harassment to the complainant.

5. In a petition filed by the complainant before the Family Court, Belgaum, seeking maintenance,
matter was settled and complainant and her children are said to have taken back by her husband with an assurance that he will look after their welfare and well being.
The said case was disposed of as not pressed.

Further, M.C.No.149/2021 filed by the husband under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, for restitution of conjugal rights was also disposed of as not pressed, since a memo was filed stating that the matter is settled with the intervention of the elderly persons and the Smt Ishwari W/O Mohan Ambiger vs State Of Karnataka on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154090287/

The learned counsel for the petitioner has also annexed at annexure F1, copy of the joint memo dated 19.09.2022 filed by the complainant and her husband, in M.C.No.149/2021 filed by the husband for restitution of conjugal rights.
In Crl.Misc.No.269/2020, filed by the wife seeking maintenance, wherein it is stated that the petitioner has joined the respondent and they are not interested to prosecute the case.
7 . Crl.P.104244/2022, preferred by accused No.3 has been allowed by this Court and the proceedings against the said accused has been quashed.

8. In the above facts and circumstances, this Court is of the considered view that the proceedings pending against the petitioners is an abuse of process of the Court and the same deserves to be quashed.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER i) Petition is allowed.

NC: 2024:KHC-D:5375 ii) The entire proceedings in C.C.No.1034/2015, pending on the file of the Court of IV JMFC Court,
Belagavi (arising out of Crime No.65.2015 of APMC Yard, Police Station Belgaum) against the petitioners are quashed.
